description: Allow the main window to listen for events the Rust side emits (BUG-044). Without this, every frontend `plugin:event|listen` call is denied by the ACL and the queue-action countdown and the weekly-update dialog never appear. Round 62: the frameless title bars (main + progress windows) also need the window controls the frontend calls — minimize / maximize / toggle-maximize / unmaximize / is-maximized / start-dragging / set-size / set-focus — plus close, which Round 61 added.
